description: Remove duplicate lines, blanks and stray spaces from a list in one pass. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

caseSensitive.description: Treat Apple and apple as different lines. Off by default, so they count as the same line and only the kept one survives.

keep.description: Which occurrence of a repeated line survives: 'first' keeps it where it first appeared, 'last' keeps it at its final position. Defaults to first.

onlyDuplicates.description: Invert the tool: return only the lines that appeared more than once, one entry each in order of first appearance, and leave the unique lines out. Off by default.

removeBlank.description: Drop empty lines entirely rather than keeping one of them. On by default.

sort.description: Order of the output: 'none' keeps the input order, 'asc' and 'desc' sort alphabetically with locale-aware, numeric-aware comparison (item2 before item10), 'length' sorts shortest line first. Defaults to none.

text.description: The lines to de-duplicate, separated by any line ending. The result is the text with repeats removed, in the original order unless sort says otherwise, plus counts of what was dropped.

trimLines.description: Strip whitespace from both ends of every line before comparing and before output. On by default. Off, trailing spaces make two lines different.

name: duplicate_line_remover
title: Remove Duplicate Lines
